scope.note: Excluded classes are maps/spaceborne products, not independent truth; addable later as separate category values for map-vs-map intercomparison.

tier_definition: coord_usability_tier: 'pixel' = coordinate error << typical map pixel (tens of m or better; rasters with exact georef), valid for 10-100 m pixel validation. 'aggregate' = coords public but error hundreds of m to km, valid only at coarse aggregation. 'restricted' = coordinates not openly available (data-request/agreement required).

datasets.name: GEO-TREES Forest Biomass Reference System
datasets.provider: GEO-TREES initiative (IIASA hosting; CNRS/Chave; Smithsonian ForestGEO; RAINFOR/ForestPlots.net)
datasets.support_size: >=0.25 ha (1 ha preferred), AGB delivered at 0.25 ha
datasets.temporal_coverage: ongoing, ~5 yr remeasurement; builds on legacy inventories (1990s-2000s)
datasets.validation_caveats: Purpose-built as a biomass-map validation reference (best-in-class). AGB via allometry + ALS/TLS calibration; 0.25 ha aggregation eases plot-to-pixel matching. Aggregated AGB + site coords are open; raw tree-level data restricted to site PIs. No single dataset DOI yet.

datasets.name: ForestPlots.net (RAINFOR, AfriTRON, T-FORCES, PPBio)
datasets.citation_short: Lopez-Gonzalez et al. 2011; ForestPlots.net et al. 2021
datasets.validation_caveats: Rich per-tree data but precise coordinates restricted; Chave et al. 2014 pantropical allometry; co-authorship/data-sharing expectations make it collaboration-only for map validation.

datasets.name: Smithsonian ForestGEO (CTFS-ForestGEO) large mapped plots
datasets.support_size: median ~25 ha (range ~2-50+ ha); stems >=1 cm DBH mapped
datasets.validation_caveats: Very large mapped plots are excellent for AGB validation (plot-to-pixel matching favorable at >=1 ha); stem maps allow sub-plot AGB. Plot locations known but full census data access is request-gated; allometry choice varies by study.

datasets.name: Tropical managed Forests Observatory (TmFO)
datasets.region: Amazon, Congo Basin/West Africa, SE Asia; ~12 countries
datasets.temporal_coverage: decades of repeat measurement; network formalized ~2012-2014
datasets.validation_caveats: Focus on logged/managed forests (useful disturbance/biomass gradient); many silvicultural-experiment plots; access collaboration-only; Chave-2014-type allometry.

datasets.name: Global Forest Biodiversity Initiative (GFBI)
datasets.temporal_coverage: aggregates inventories over many decades; ongoing
datasets.format: GFBI Data Management System; tabular exports
datasets.citation_short: Liang et al. 2016; Gatti/Liang et al. 2022
datasets.validation_caveats: Enormous coverage but heterogeneous protocols and plot sizes (many small -> plot-to-pixel mismatch); coordinates restricted; best used via collaboration.

datasets.name: NEON terrestrial vegetation structure (DP1.10098.001)
datasets.region: USA (CONUS, AK, HI, PR); 47 terrestrial sites
datasets.validation_caveats: Small base plots (0.16 ha) -> plot-to-pixel mismatch for coarse AGB maps; AGB not provided (apply allometry); tree locations reconstructable with meter-level coordinateUncertainty; US only.

datasets.name: TERN Biomass Plot Library + AusPlots (Australia)
datasets.region: Australia (continental; gaps in GWW, Kimberley, Cape York)
datasets.support_size: variable, many <0.1 ha; AusPlots Forest = 48 x 1 ha
datasets.validation_caveats: Open coordinates + CC-BY = highly usable, BUT many plots <0.1 ha -> severe plot-to-pixel mismatch for satellite AGB; pre-2000 GPS accuracy limits; biomass modeled (allometric), not weighed. Not a probability-based inventory (a collation) -> heterogeneous protocols.

datasets.name: SWAMP mangrove biomass database
datasets.region: tropical/subtropical mangroves (SE Asia, LatAm, Africa, Pacific)
datasets.validation_caveats: Specialist mangrove use only; heterogeneous plot sizes; mangrove-specific allometry (Komiyama/Chave); georeferencing is a QA criterion so plot locations are released.

datasets.name: ICP Forests Level II intensive monitoring plots
datasets.provider: ICP Forests / Thuenen Institute PCC (UNECE CLRTAP)
datasets.validation_caveats: Primarily an air-pollution/forest-condition network (biomass secondary); exact coordinates restricted; European temperate/boreal only -> limited direct use for AGB map validation.

datasets.name: USA Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA)
datasets.units: Mg/ha (from tree dry biomass; also carbon, volume)
datasets.support_size: 4-subplot cluster (~0.067 ha; each subplot 24 ft radius)
datasets.access: open (fuzzed; DataMart) / on-request (exact via Spatial Data Services)
datasets.validation_caveats: Public coords perturbed within 0.5 mi (up to 1 mi) and a subset of private plots swapped within county -> precludes true pixel-level validation; best at aggregate/estimation-unit scale unless exact coords obtained. Standout: publishes tree dry biomass/carbon directly (no external allometry).

datasets.name: France NFI (IGN)
datasets.provider: IGN (Institut national de l'information geographique et forestiere)
datasets.units: m3/ha (+ tree DBH/height; AGB needs conversion)
datasets.validation_caveats: Published node coordinates only; true plot within max 700 m -> aggregate scale, not strict pixel matching. Open raw data omit statistical weights (cannot reproduce official estimates); rotating panel = mostly single-visit; volume -> AGB conversion required.

datasets.name: Spain Inventario Forestal Nacional (IFN)
datasets.native_crs: EPSG:23030 (ED50 UTM30, peninsula); EPSG:32628 (WGS84 UTM28, Canaries)
datasets.validation_caveats: Peninsula datum is ED50 -> MUST reproject to WGS84/ETRS89 (~200 m shift if ignored). Coordinate precision adequate for plot-level use but confirm per cycle; IFN4 incomplete for some provinces; volume -> AGB conversion required.

datasets.name: Sweden NFI (Riksskogstaxeringen, SLU)
datasets.temporal_coverage: since 1923; annual with 5 yr remeasurement of permanent plots
datasets.access: open (PXWeb stats + RS-validation subset) / data-request (exact coords)
datasets.validation_caveats: Exact plot coordinates confidential. An open RS-validation subset of temporary plots exists but is explicitly not for totals/averages, omits boundary plots, and its coordinate precision is undocumented -> verify before pixel-level use. Full coordinates require an SLU agreement.

datasets.name: Finland NFI (VMI, Luke) + MS-NFI
datasets.n_records_or_area: tens of thousands of field plots per cycle
datasets.validation_caveats: The open product is a MODEL-BASED raster (satellite + plots), NOT independent plot observations -> circular if validating a similar map. True in-situ plot validation requires restricted Luke data.

datasets.name: Germany NFI (Bundeswaldinventur, BWI)
datasets.support_size: angle-count (relascope) sampling, no fixed radius; 4 km grid
datasets.n_records_or_area: cluster points on 4x4 km grid (denser in some Laender)
datasets.validation_caveats: Public coordinates anonymized to 1 km INSPIRE grid -> pixel-level (10-30 m) validation impossible with public data. Angle-count design means no fixed plot radius, complicating footprint definition even with exact coords.

datasets.name: Switzerland NFI (LFI, WSL)
datasets.validation_caveats: No public plot coordinates (Geoinformation Ordinance restricts plot data; sample integrity + privacy) -> pixel-level validation needs a WSL data agreement. See Schadauer et al. 2024 (New Phytologist).

datasets.name: Norway NFI (Landsskogtakseringen, NIBIO)
datasets.temporal_coverage: since 1919; permanent-plot grid since 1986-93; 5 yr remeasurement
datasets.format: SSB stats API; plot data on request
datasets.validation_caveats: Exact plot coordinates not public -> pixel-level validation needs a NIBIO agreement. Within-plot tree coordinates exist but are part of the restricted microdata.

datasets.name: Italy NFI (INFC)
datasets.access: registration (open raw tree data) / coords withheld
datasets.license: free EXCEPT compiling Italian forest statistics; mandatory citation
datasets.validation_caveats: Rich biomass/carbon content but precise plot coordinates NOT distributed (plots located only by coarse/administrative reference) -> blocks pixel-level validation. Licensing forbids reuse for producing Italian forest statistics.

datasets.name: United Kingdom NFI (Forest Research)
datasets.support_size: 1 km sample squares; woodland-map polygons >=0.5 ha
datasets.temporal_coverage: rolling since 2009; map updated annually; 5 yr field cycle
datasets.n_records_or_area: field squares within NFI woodland map
datasets.access: open (woodland map polygons) / data-request (field plot subsets)
datasets.validation_caveats: Open product is land-cover polygons, not biomass plots. Field-plot biomass/coordinate validation requires a data request; plot coordinates likely not released at full precision.

datasets.name: Canada NFI
datasets.support_size: ground plots (subsample); photo plots 2x2 km on 20 km grid
datasets.validation_caveats: Open release carries GENERALIZED (grid) coordinates only -> precludes pixel matching; exact coords via NFI Data Request Form. MAGPlot aggregates 12 jurisdictions with heterogeneous protocols/coordinate policies.

datasets.name: Poland NFI (WISL, BULiGL)
datasets.provider: Bureau for Forest Management and Geodesy (BULiGL) / State Forests
datasets.support_size: clusters of 5 plots on 4 km grid
datasets.access: open (BDL stand data/maps) / restricted (NFI plot coords)
datasets.validation_caveats: NFI plot coordinates not publicly released (BDL offers stand-level data, not exact plot coords) -> pixel-level validation not feasible from open sources.

datasets.name: Netherlands NFI (NBI, WUR/Probos)
datasets.validation_caveats: Coordinate availability/precision NOT confirmed in sources -> verify directly with Probos/WUR before pixel-level use.

datasets.name: Sustainable Landscapes Brazil airborne LiDAR (EMBRAPA/USFS)
datasets.provider: US Forest Service + EMBRAPA; archived under NASA CMS at ORNL DAAC
datasets.support_size: 1 ha AGB; 1 m CHM (~1 km2 sample tiles)
datasets.citation_short: dos-Santos, Keller et al. (Sustainable Landscapes Brazil)
datasets.validation_caveats: Sample tiles, NOT a continuous reference map -> intersect per-axis and assert n>0. AGB model-derived from lidar metrics + local plots; wide 2008-2018 acquisition span risks year mismatch. Get extent from tile footprints, not site names. DOI unconfirmed - resolve on guide page.

datasets.name: AfriSAR AGB maps: Lope, Mabounie, Mondah, Rabi (Gabon)
datasets.validation_caveats: Site-level AGB from allometry + lidar; only 4 small AOIs, some non-forest (savanna/disturbed) mixed in -> verify per-site footprint overlap with the map cell being validated.

datasets.name: AfriSAR gridded forest biomass & canopy metrics from LVIS (Gabon)
datasets.support_size: 25 m (metrics); AGBD at 50 m and 100 m
datasets.validation_caveats: AGBD only at 3 of 5 sites; full-waveform (LVIS) footprint differs from discrete lidar; AGB model calibrated on Gabon plots -> do not extrapolate outside Gabon forest types.

datasets.name: NEON Airborne Observation Platform (AOP) lidar / CHM
datasets.region: USA (81 NEON sites incl. AK, HI, PR)
datasets.validation_caveats: Ships structure, NOT AGB -> any AGB is your own allometric model (added uncertainty). 'Total biomass map' DP3.30016.001 is spectrometer-derived, not lidar-AGB. Small site AOIs; provisional vs released data differ.

datasets.name: NASA G-LiHT (Goddard LiDAR, Hyperspectral & Thermal)
datasets.provider: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; LP DAAC
datasets.region: USA (incl. Alaska), Mexico, Central America, other campaign sites
datasets.access: open (G-LiHT portal; Earthdata login for LP DAAC)
datasets.validation_caveats: No official AGB layer -> biomass is user-modeled. Narrow swaths -> sparse coverage; match swath footprint and acquisition date to the map cell. Mixed product formats/orientations.

datasets.name: NASA CMS LiDAR-derived AGB, California forests
datasets.provider: Xu & Greenberg (UC); NASA CMS / ORNL DAAC
datasets.validation_caveats: Coverage is 53 patches, not wall-to-wall CA -> assert overlap with target cells. Wide 2005-2014 acquisition window -> year mismatch risk. Individual-tree-crown allometry with commission/omission corrections.

datasets.name: NASA CMS LiDAR-derived biomass/canopy, Sonoma County CA
datasets.validation_caveats: A separate 'improved for high-biomass forests' Sonoma product exists (guide Sonoma_County_Forest_AGB) - do not conflate. This parametric cover/height model underpredicts in tall redwood stands.

datasets.name: NASA CMS LiDAR-derived Forest AGB, Northwestern USA (V2)
datasets.region: WA, OR, ID, western MT, USA (176 lidar collections)
datasets.citation_short: Forest AGB NW USA V2 (ORNL 2443; V1 1766)
datasets.validation_caveats: Random-forest model from lidar + climate + SRTM; NOT continuous regionwide (per-collection footprints). Broad 2002-2016 window. A companion Landsat-based annual product (2000-2016) is modeled, not direct lidar -> keep separate.

datasets.name: NASA CMS LiDAR-AGB: Tri-State (MD/PA/DE) & RGGI (NE USA)
datasets.validation_caveats: V1/V2 versions exist for Tri-State - cite the version. Mixed state lidar vintages within one mosaic. DOIs unconfirmed - resolve on the ORNL guide pages (each has a 10.3334/ORNLDAAC/xxxx).

datasets.name: Global Airborne Observatory: Forest Carbon Stocks of Peru
datasets.provider: Asner et al., Arizona State University (GAO); Peru MINAM
datasets.n_records_or_area: national map (lidar samples fused with satellite)
datasets.validation_caveats: Units are CARBON (Mg C/ha), NOT biomass -> multiply by ~2.08 (divide by ~0.48) for AGB Mg/ha (silent factor-of-2 trap). Only sampled areas are true lidar; the rest is satellite-extrapolated. 2012 vintage -> mismatch with newer maps.

datasets.name: Global Airborne Observatory: Canopy Height & Carbon, Sabah (Borneo)
datasets.provider: Asner, Brodrick, Heckler, Arizona State University (GAO)
datasets.region: Sabah, Malaysian Borneo (incl. Danum, Maliau, Imbak)
datasets.validation_caveats: ACD is CARBON, not biomass (same ~/0.48 conversion caveat). This is the state-wide GAO product; SAFE/Danum/Maliau plot networks are separate ground data. 2016 vintage.

datasets.name: SAFE Project / Sabah Borneo airborne-lidar AGB
datasets.region: Sabah, Borneo (Danum, Maliau, SAFE landscape, oil palm)
datasets.temporal_coverage: lidar Nov 2014 (oil palm) and 2016 (GAO); plots ongoing
datasets.access: open/registration (NERC EDS, Zenodo, SAFE data portal)
datasets.validation_caveats: 'SAFE Borneo AGB' spans several separate acquisitions and providers -> do NOT treat as one homogeneous layer. Carbon vs biomass unit confusion. Steep terrain degrades lidar ground detection at some Sabah sites.

datasets.name: Paracou / French Guiana airborne lidar (ALS) + AGB
datasets.provider: CIRAD/IRD (Vincent), Univ. Cambridge (Jackson, Coomes); ESA TropiSAR
datasets.support_size: 1 m CHM; 1 ha plot AGB (16 x 6.25 ha Paracou plots)
datasets.validation_caveats: CEDA/Zenodo products are point cloud + CHM, NOT AGB rasters -> AGB comes from the Paracou plot census + allometry (BIOMASS/Chave). Very small AOI (~10 km2). Confirm plot-to-lidar footprint and census-year alignment.

datasets.name: TERN AusCover airborne LiDAR/hyperspectral SuperSites (Australia)
datasets.support_size: lidar ~0.3 m; product grid varies (5x5 km sites)
datasets.validation_caveats: AGB is a derived per-site product with Australian sclerophyll/savanna allometry (not comparable to tropical allometries). Small 25 km2 tiles; some sites are drone-lidar. Per-site DOIs not individually verified.

datasets.name: DRC & Central Africa airborne-lidar reference AGB
datasets.provider: Xu, Saatchi et al. (DRC map); Scientific Data 2024 multi-site reference maps
datasets.region: DRC (national) + 8 Central African / South Asian sites
datasets.support_size: reference maps 40 m and 100 m; DRC national ~1 ha
datasets.n_records_or_area: DRC lidar >432,000 ha over 33 transects; reference footprint ~111,650 ha
datasets.validation_caveats: DRC national map is transect-lidar extrapolated by satellite ML -> only transects are true lidar; assert overlap. Height-to-AGB allometry (Xu et al.) fit on only 92 plots. Check carbon-vs-biomass units per product.
